verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਥੇਕੈ ਦੁਇ ਖੜਗੁ ਦੁਇ ਪਾਤਸਾਹ ਨ ਮੁਲਕਿ ਸਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: eikat thekai dhui khaRag dhui paatasaeh na mulak samaanai|

en.bdb: In one sheath two swords and two emperors in one country cannot be accommodated;

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੀਹ ਫਕੀਰ ਮਸੀਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਿੰਥ ਖਿੰਧੋਲੀ ਹੇਠਿ ਲੁਕਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: veeh fakeer maseet vich khi(n)th khi(n)dholee heTh lukaanai|

en.bdb: But twenty faquirs in one mosque under one patched blanket can remain (comfortably).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੰਗਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੀਹ ਦੁਇ ਪੋਸਤ ਡੋਡੇ ਖਸਖਸ ਦਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: ja(n)gal a(n)dhar seeh dhui posat ddodde khasakhas dhaanai|

en.bdb: Emperors are like two lions in a jungle whereas the faquirs are like the opium seeds in one pod.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਲੀ ਉਪਰਿ ਖੇਲਣਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਬਜਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: soolee upar khelanaa sir dhar chhatr bajaar vikaanai|

en.bdb: These seeds play on the 'bed of thorns before they get the honour of selling in the market.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਲੂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪੀੜੀਅਨਿ ਪੋਸਤਿ ਪੀਹਿ ਪਿਆਲੇ ਛਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: koloo a(n)dhar peeReean posat peeh piaale chhaanai|

en.bdb: They are rushed in the press with water before they are strained into the cup .

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਉਬਾਲੀ ਦਰਗਾਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਨਾਹੀ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: laubaalee dharagaeh vich garab gunaahee maan nimaanai|

en.bdb: In the court of the fearless Lord, the proud ones are called sinners and the humble get respects and regards.
That is why the gurmukhs though powerful behave as the meek ones.
